text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. According to Tamamo 
Cross,
her little brother got into a brawl 
with a neighborhood kid over who was 
faster: Tamamo or Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's running has a strange way of 
captivating people.
I can't help wondering 
what her secret is. This summer,
I decided 
to sit down and have a good talk with her.
